mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT x.tenant_id FROM ( SELECT b.tenant_id AS tenant_id FROM external_project_binding b INNER JOIN `org` o ON o.id = b.tenant_id AND o.is_deleted = 1 WHERE b.enabled = 1 AND b.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT t.workspace_id AS tenant_id FROM scheduled_task t INNER JOIN `org` o2 ON o2.id = t.workspace_id AND o2.is_deleted = 1 WHERE t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT d.tenant_id AS tenant_id FROM dispatch d INNER JOIN `org` o3 ON o3.id = d.tenant_id AND o3.is_deleted = 1 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.status IN #{s} ) x ORDER BY x.tenant_id LIMIT #{limit}
